prompt:
Analyze the following external review that has been addressed.
Identify what our INTERNAL code review should have caught
BEFORE the external reviewer found it.

## External Review Feedback


## Code Comments (with Resolutions)
- [operators/keystone/internal/controller/keystone_controller.go:62] I expect this to happen on somewhat of a regular basis. Please don't log this as ``Info`` maybe as ``Debug`` if at all.
- [operators/keystone/internal/controller/keystone_controller_test.go:273] Useless test. We certainly do not need to test, if a struct we just created has values we assign to it. This tests go-lang more than it helps us in any way testing the controller.
- [operators/keystone/internal/controller/reconcile_config.go:93] Explicitly constructing a ``url.URL`` object and using ``url.UserPassword`` seems appropriate and correct
- [operators/keystone/internal/controller/keystone_controller_test.go:324] We have ``internal/conditions`` for this kind of stuff and I am pretty sure this - again - reimplements ``meta.FindStatusCondition(conditions, conditionType)``
- [operators/keystone/internal/controller/reconcile_config.go:103] While functionally identical, I suggest using ``defaults`` as the second argument to this function. This makes it easier to understand what is going on when reading the code.
- [operators/keystone/internal/controller/reconcile_deployment.go:167] Thats what the ``k8s.io/utils/ptr`` package is for. Use that instead of reinventing functions
- [operators/keystone/api/v1alpha1/keystone_types.go:124] I am pretty sure changing the API structs requires us to re-run ``make generate`` to re-generate the auto-generated files.
- [internal/common/types/types.go:67] This needs to have a ``make regenerate`` as well.

## Resolution Summary
All 8 review comments from gndrmnn were addressed. The changes include: downgrading a log from Info to Debug via V(1), removing a useless test that only verified struct assignment, replacing a custom findCondition helper with meta.FindStatusCondition (applied to 6 test files beyond the one mentioned: reconcile_bootstrap_test.go, reconcile_database_test.go, reconcile_deployment_test.go, reconcile_fernet_test.go, reconcile_secrets_test.go in addition to keystone_controller_test.go), changing the MergeDefaults second argument to defaults for clarity, replacing a custom boolPtr function with ptr.To from k8s.io/utils/ptr (also promoting k8s.io/utils to a direct dependency in go.mod), and regenerating CRD manifests to reflect API struct changes in both keystone_types.go and internal/common/types/types.go.

Extract 0-3 review improvement patterns. For each:
- name: Short, action-oriented name IN ENGLISH
- review_area: error-handling | security | testing | performance | type-safety | validation | architecture | naming | documentation
- detection_hint: How should the reviewer detect this?
- severity: BLOCKING | WARNING
- what_to_check: What exactly to check
- why_it_matters: Why it matters
- example_feedback: Original quote from the reviewer
- example_fix: What was changed

QUALITY: Only real review blindspots. No subjective style opinions.
Nothing that only a domain expert could know.
If nothing extractable: empty array.

LANGUAGE: ALL fields MUST be in English.

Response: ONLY JSON array.
